matching_rules.algorithm_normalization: uppercase; family extracted by longest-prefix match (e.g. RSA-2048 -> RSA, SHA-1 stays SHA-1)
matching_rules.counting: a fixture finding matches an expected label at most once; duplicate detections of same algorithm in one file collapse
matching_rules.ignored_families_rationale: import/library-level informational labels are not algorithm detections; they are excluded from algorithm-precision scoring rather than suppressed at the scanner layer
